title.narrative: Operating the mobile clinics system in Saada and Hajjah governorates

description.narrative: Providing primary healthcare services to (52,124) beneficiaries, enabling medical, technical, and support staff to work in clinics, and providing a safe and healthy environment.

Providing primary healthcare services, trauma treatment and dressing services, safe disposal of medical waste and debris, saving and preserving lives, reducing the spread of diseases and epidemics, and providing emergency healthcare services.
